finding.title: Open redirect in Redirects.after_login
finding.description: A protocol-relative target such as //host is returned unchanged as the post-login redirect.

plan.hypothesis: If the input described for the exploit probe (target '//evil.example/phish', a scheme-relative URL to another host) reaches Redirects.after_login without confinement or encoding, then: Returns '//evil.example/phish' unchanged, so the user is sent off the site (an unaffected implementation returns '/')

control.seam: Call the real Redirects.after_login through its public interface
control.input_description: target '/account', a path on this site

exploit.seam: Call the real Redirects.after_login through its public interface
exploit.input_description: target '//evil.example/phish', a scheme-relative URL to another host
exploit.property_to_assert: Returns '//evil.example/phish' unchanged, so the user is sent off the site (an unaffected implementation returns '/')

control.source:
require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'redirects'

class RedirectsControlTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'start'), '')
    holds = Redirects.after_login('/home') == '/account'
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'check'), holds ? 'holds' : 'violated')
    assert holds, ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_TOKEN')
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'end'), '')
  end
end

source_files.content:
# Where to send a user after sign-in.
module Redirects
  def self.after_login(target)
    return '/' if target.nil? || target.empty?
    target
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'redirects'

class RedirectsTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_defaults_to_home
    assert_equal '/', Redirects.after_login(nil)
  end
end
